errors.evidence: The chart has a total of six sectors. After describing three of them (orange, red, green), only three sectors remain, not four. The description invents a fourth color, "тъмносин" (dark blue), which does not exist in the legend or the chart.

errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that percentage labels are present for only two sectors. The chart clearly shows a percentage label (13,6%) for the green sector ("От 16 до 30 години") as well.

errors.text_span: Секторите са разположени в кръговата диаграма в низходящ ред по размер, като най-големите сектори са разположени в горната част, а по-малките са разположени в долната част.
errors.evidence: This is an incorrect description of the chart's layout. The sectors are not arranged in descending order of size, nor are the largest sectors at the top. The two largest sectors (red and orange) are on the left and bottom-left, while a mid-sized sector (green, 13.6%) is at the top.
